text.intro:
The Inverlaig ferry runs a full day of crossings in theory, and a variable number in practice.
Five skippers are involved. Determine each skipper's start time, cargo and vessel.
- **Skipper**: Ruaridh, Murdo, Senga, Tormod and Fearghas.
- **Start time** (listed from earlier to later): 8am, 9am, 10am, 11am and noon.
- **Notable cargo**: a consignment of bees; a church organ; a brass band; a film crew and no permits; and a refrigerated van.
- **Vessel**: the Tern, the Broch Maid, the Siller Grey, the Three Brothers and the Kelpie.
Every skipper has a different start time, cargo and vessel, so within each category every item is used exactly once.
clues: The skipper who carries a film crew and no permits commands the Tern.
9am is exactly one hour earlier than Fearghas, with no start time in between.
Tormod is exactly one hour earlier than 9am, with no start time in between.
The skipper who carries a brass band falls somewhere between 11am and the skipper who commands the Broch Maid in start time order.
At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) Ruaridh is earlier than noon in start time order. (b) The skipper who carries a church organ commands the Kelpie.
9am is exactly one hour earlier than the skipper who carries a church organ, with no start time in between.
The skipper who carries a brass band and Senga both sit at odd-numbered hours or both at even-numbered hours.

At least one of the following holds, and possibly more than one: (a) Fearghas and the skipper who commands the Broch Maid are exactly one hour apart in start time order, in one direction or the other. (b) The skipper who carries a church organ and the skipper who commands the Three Brothers both sit at odd-numbered hours or both at even-numbered hours.
The skipper who commands the Three Brothers is earlier than Senga in start time order. The skipper who carries a refrigerated van is earlier than Senga in start time order.
The skipper who carries a church organ is exactly one hour earlier than the skipper who commands the Siller Grey, with no start time in between.
